change.cause: Cold Continue applied inert to the whole guide toolbar while resumePending, leaving enabled-looking Settings/Help/language unreachable. Native Resume removed the gate and then the same Settings opened.
change.behavior: Gameplay layout/stage and guided exit remain gated until Resume. Comfort/language/help are available while continue-pending; conflict/unreadable/restart toolbar blocking remains. Both renderSave and renderPause use the same gate.
change.protected: No engine, gameplay, save-codec, assets or dependency delta.

tests.scope: 12 preference combinations/strict V5 roundtrip,300 causal ticks identical across visual policy for14 actors/5 habitats, original4 Zebra reduced/low rigs retain essential displacement/gait; original audio/policy/controller/pause/restart suites.

build.qaExclusion: PASS including factory faults and pointer diagnostics

browser.mutedColdAndStoredUnmute: No graph at cold menu/Continue. Native Apply/Resume creates one graph; settled running AudioContext and nonzero analyser samples verified. Pause/dialog/mute gain0; all4 sessions close their sole context.
browser.audioScope: Actual native WebAudio graph/signal, not physical speaker audibility. Suspended/muted analyser can retain its last buffer, so gain/context state establish silence rather than demanding stale RMS0. An initial observation labelled playing was still waiting during the async transition; only later settled records accept running playback.
browser.motionScope: Manual native reduced setting and actual native media query observed. Source policy tests cover system reduced=true; OS preference/physical-device changes are not claimed. Essential movement source-tested; frozen0ms browser cases retain all14 models and exact gameplay.
browser.faultScope: Explicit null-once WebGL/throw-once audio factory injection through original production seams. Visible bilingual fallback/help/unavailable feedback and retries to actual native factories; not hardware-unsupported or native autoplay-denial evidence.
browser.storageScope: QA disables global menu preference storage to protect owner namespaces. Native UI truthfully reports temporary menu preferences; actual isolated durable V5 preferences persist and restore exactly.
limitations: Native QA inspector clicks sometimes timed out after execution; fresh source-bound reports confirmed outcomes before proceeding, without repeating uncertain mutations. Heavy QA ray projections are not a game FPS benchmark.
Complete keyboard/focus/help/context-loss matrix remains Z5-05/R7; physical-device/native background/full posed-scene/performance/15-minute soak gates remain separate.
browser.console: Captured warn/error logs empty in the normal audio check and both final fault sessions.

Satu langkah peduli setiap kali

Coba misi pertama sekarang: pratinjau dan konfirmasi habitat, sambungkan petak jalur yang disorot, lalu klaim hadiah. Batal selalu gratis.

Bangun rumah yang aman
Tempatkan habitat dan hubungkan ke pintu masuk dengan jalan.
Rawat dua makaw
Sediakan makanan, air, dan tempat istirahat. Amati respons mereka.
Sambut pengunjung
Jalan yang terhubung akan membawa tamu dan pemasukan tiket.
Jaga suaka tetap tumbuh
Ikuti Misi dari Q01 sampai Q04 dan klaim setiap hadiah sekali. Jeda dengan aman, periksa status simpan, lalu gunakan Lanjutkan dan Lanjut bermain saat kembali.

Gunakan Misi untuk langkah berikutnya, Rawat untuk kebutuhan satwa dan Opsi untuk pengaturan tampilan dan suara. Jeda menghentikan dunia. Lanjutkan memuat dalam keadaan dijeda; tidak ada progres offline.

Kebutuhan dan kesejahteraan dalam game adalah aturan sederhana, bukan petunjuk merawat satwa nyata. Bagian Learn menjelaskan perbedaan ini sambil menyiapkan artikel berbasis sumber.

One kind step at a time

Try the first mission now: preview and confirm a habitat, connect the highlighted path tiles, then claim your reward. Cancel is always free.

Build a safe home
Place a habitat and connect it to the entrance with a path.
Care for two macaws
Offer food, water and a place to rest. Watch how they respond.
Welcome visitors
Connected paths will bring guests and ticket income.
Keep the creek thriving
Follow Missions through Q01–Q04 and claim each reward once. Pause safely, check save status, then use Continue and Resume when returning.

Use Missions for the next action, Care for animal needs and Options for visual and sound settings. Pause stops the world. Continue loads paused; no offline progress is added.

Game needs and welfare are simplified rules, not wildlife-care instructions. The journal’s Learn section explains this distinction while researched articles are being prepared.
